note: Fork-owned release contract for Codr (`kevsmir02/terax-ai`). The stable endpoint and minisign trust root (key ID 94097B75DB498B21) were settled in breakdown ticket #39 (GitHub issue #40). The inherited upstream endpoint is kept only so tests and code can refuse it. src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is compared against this file by tests instead of duplicating logic.

trust.note: Minisign public key provisioned offline for Codr releases (key ID 94097B75DB498B21). Discovery verifies the signature envelope and key ID while failing closed on mismatches or unverified metadata; full artifact bytes are verified before publishing and on package verification.

fixtures.note: Development and tests point the contract at the isolated fixture directory (served over 127.0.0.1 by scripts/update-fixtures.mjs). A loopback endpoint is the only override accepted in development, and a development build marks those releases as fixture-unverified rather than verified.
